items.reason: Gap 1 describes two deliveries of the same event running concurrently so both workers see the id absent and execute the handler.
Gap 0 says the HMAC covers only the body so a signed delivery replayed with a modified X-Event-Id bypasses deduplication.
Gap 3 says the provider sends charge.refunded while HANDLERS registers only refund.created, so no refund is recorded.
No gap depends on multiple processes or replicas; the concurrency described is among the one queue's workers.
